summary: The candidate is a valid partial fix for a related QSA/NEXTN draft-extend metadata crash: the base reads draft_token_num from EagleDraftExtendInput, where only num_tokens_per_req exists, and the candidate's canonical-width change fixes that failure. It does not reproduce, prevent, or verify resolution of the original GB10 TP2 HTTP-200 silent semantic corruption. It removes a crash and allows the unqualified graph path to proceed without a fail-closed guard or model-level eager/graph semantic evidence.

tests.what_was_measured: At the exact recorded base, real draft-extend metadata raises AttributeError because EagleDraftExtendInput has no draft_token_num.
At the exact candidate commit, five focused candidate regressions passed.
Independent widths 1 and 4, differing verify canonical/legacy widths, no-speculation behavior, and a gfx950 tensor case returned the expected host bounds.
Three gfx950 GPU tests passed against independent Torch or legacy host references.
Full QSA unit file: 41 passed and one NVIDIA SM121-only test skipped.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 with ROCm 7.2 executed three QSA GPU reference tests; this is not the issue's NVIDIA GB10/SM121 TP2 environment.

remaining_counterexamples: The reported decode-graph profile can still return corrupt 1,024-token punctuation-loop output; the candidate provides no semantic eager/graph result or fail-closed guard.
The reported approximately 25K-token ordered-marker retrieval can still lose markers and degenerate into punctuation; the candidate provides no model-level result.
The original 2x GB10 SM121 TP2/RoCEv2 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 configuration remains untested.
remaining_limitations: No NVIDIA GB10/SM121 GPU was available; the SM121-only test was skipped.
Only one AMD gfx950 GPU was assigned, so TP2, RoCEv2, dual-node, and CUDA graph behavior could not be exercised.
Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 weights were unavailable, so the original HTTP semantic qualification harness could not be run.
No native source changed; a native rebuild was not applicable.
The tiny Llama fixture was not used because it cannot qualify QSA/NEXTN model semantics.
